description: Land Title Settlement Department - Malandeniya, Deraniyagala D/S Division, Kegalla District - Cad. Map No.610558 (24/0250)
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration and the declaration of land ownership determinations for specific parcels of land. It involves the Commissioner of Title Settlement exercising powers under the Registration of Title Act to declare ownership status of multiple land parcels, which falls squarely under land and property-related matters as defined in Type 4 (Land Gazettes). The content does not involve government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or any of the other specialized categories.
